name: Straight River (Medford–Faribault)

gaugeContext.note: The Faribault station provides same-river flow context. Tributaries and local channel conditions vary across these reaches; this reading is not a calibrated trip-speed model.

blurb: Choose shorter or longer paddles between the County Road 45 landing, Medford, Kroghs Landing and Teepee Tonka Park. DNR notes that spring and early summer usually offer better water levels; shallow rocky channels and snags can make later trips difficult. These listings begin below Owatonna Dam and Clinton Falls.

sections.takeOut: Straight River Medford City Park Access
sections.difficulty: Moving water; rocky channels and snags possible
sections.notes: A shorter paddle from the county carry-in to Straight River Park in Medford. This launch is below Clinton Falls. Arrange a vehicle shuttle and check for low water, snags and bridge debris.
sections.routeReview: Approximate agency river-course overview. Exact landing connections, current obstructions and alternate channels are not mapped.

sections.notes: Paddle north from Medford to Kroghs Landing. Identify the take-out during your shuttle; it is just downstream of the former mill site. This is a moving-water trip with a rapid near the end.

sections.takeOut: Straight River Teepee Tonka Park Access
sections.difficulty: Moving water; rocky channels and snags possible
sections.notes: Start below the former Walcott Mill Dam rapids and continue past River Bend Nature Center to Faribault. The DNR map marks a large midstream boulder near mile 6.9. Finish at the designated park carry-in, before the separate downstream Bridge-to-Park access.
sections.routeReview: The agency line differs from the visible channel near a railway crossing below Kroghs Landing. Access areas and published planning distances remain available; no dotted course is shown for this trip.
